notes: Paper IS SMOTE; there is no plain-SMOTE baseline. Proposed method as presented = SMOTE (k=5 nearest neighbours) combined with random majority under-sampling; ROC curves built by varying under-sampling at fixed SMOTE %. Comparisons: Under-C4.5 and Under-Ripper (plain under-sampling), Ripper Loss Ratio, Naive Bayes with varied priors (compared against SMOTE-C4.5), C4.5 decision thresholds (Phoneme), replication over-sampling (Mammography), SHRINK/one-sided selection (Oil, Tables 4-5, Acc+/Acc-). Only Table 3 gives per-dataset numbers (AUC, C4.5 only); Ripper and Naive Bayes results are ROC plots only (Figs 7-29) and AUCs for Ripper/Naive Bayes are explicitly not included. Table 5 (p.27, printed 347) gives Acc+/Acc- for 500% SMOTE + under-sampling 10%-800% on Oil vs Table 4 SHRINK 82.5%/60.9% and One-sided selection 76.0%/86.6%. Variants also introduced: SMOTE-NC (tested on Adult) and SMOTE-N (proposed, not tested). Paper notes exceptions: Pima (Naive Bayes dominates SMOTE-C4.5), Oil (Under-Ripper dominates SMOTE-Ripper), Can (overlap). A copy 'SMOTE (Original).pdf' exists in Binary folder; not read. Page indices are PDF page numbers; printed page = PDF page + 320.
